items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: and Fred Whelan, and Al Seidel on drums.

ctx.x: Yeah. Now here's one with Brunis, you see, and Joe Marsali, and Joe Bushkin, Eddie Condon, and Fred Whelan, and Al Seidel on drums. But that wasn't... I was playing with him at the time, 1937.
That wasn't the next band hardly at all except for Brunis, huh?
